raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's three-layered architecture (Observe, Intelligence, Execution) that moves from telemetry to automated agent deployment is genuinely new. It offers a comprehensive, closed-loop system for AI automation at scale, addressing the lack of unified solutions in the market.
raw.thesis: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies that aims to provide a comprehensive solution for observing, understanding, and automating work processes through AI. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an observation layer to capture work patterns, an intelligence layer to interpret employee intent and business value of tasks, and an execution layer to automatically generate and deploy AI agents. This venture is for AI-first companies struggling with the lack of clear ROI and operational drift in their AI automation efforts. The problem Narma addresses is severe, as enterprises currently lack concrete telemetry to measure AI savings, struggle with unreliable ROI, and experience constant drift in their AI systems and human capital, leading to inefficiencies and missed opportunities. The founder's goal appears to be a growth startup, given the focus on "AI automation at scale" and solving enterprise-level problems. Based on the description, the venture is at the idea stage, as it outlines a conceptual solution without mentioning any existing product or traction. Narma positions itself as a replacement for fragmented or non-existent solutions currently used by enterprises to manage AI automation, offering a unified platform for insights and agent deployment.
raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" with a three-layered architecture: Observe (Layer 1) uses lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns; Intelligence Layer (Layer 2) detects employee intent, business value, and operational drift; Execution Layer (Layer 3) is an "Agent Factory" that generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. Its vision is a single system for continuous AI lift.
raw.core_excitement: The founder is excited by the prospect of a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure "Continuous AI lift" for AI-first companies.
raw.one_liner: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale.
